convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for BBSqueeze indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for calculation
UpSignalTime - timestamp for long entry signal
DnSignalTime - timestamp for short entry signal

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: sell signal triggers BUY_Close, buy signal triggers SELL_Close

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values treated as fixed lot size (e.g. -0.1 = 0.1 lots), positive values treated as deposit fraction/share

custom_logic_notes: Entry requires both histogram buffers to be active simultaneously: long entry needs UpValue[1] (histogram positive) AND DnValue[0] (signal line present); short entry needs DnValue[1] (histogram negative) AND UpValue[0] (signal line present). This is a squeeze breakout system where both the momentum histogram and signal line must confirm. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from the previous completed bar. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans act as permission gates. TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles position checking and execution internally.
python_conversion_notes: BBSqueeze is a custom indicator combining Bollinger Bands and Keltner Channels squeeze detection with a momentum histogram. Must reimplement the BBSqueeze logic in Python (BB with configurable smoothing method + KC comparison + histogram calculation). SmoothAlgorithms.mqh provides 10+ smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA beyond standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA) - each needs Python implementation. TradeAlgorithms.mqh encapsulates position management, margin checks, and order execution - must replicate its BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions. The conditional MM logic (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) must be preserved. The signal logic uses two buffers: buffer 0 is the up/positive histogram, buffer 1 is the down/negative histogram, and both must be non-empty to trigger entries.
